Hi Samantha — great to hear from you and thanks for the RFP. We can absolutely support a pilot and want to make the reference experience valuable for both you and our customers. Two quick notes up front:

- We actively manage reference requests to avoid "reference fatigue" for our most engaged customers; that means we sometimes limit the number of live calls per quarter and route newer requests to substitutes (short recorded case studies or less-frequent contacts).
- If live calls are must-have, we can prioritize one live customer call + one recorded deep-dive, or surface two live contacts if availability permits.

Could you confirm which time windows next week work for you (PST preferred) and whether finance vs. e‑commerce is a hard requirement? I attached our short reference intake form — once you fill that out it helps the team route appropriately.

Options we can do quickly:
- Option A: 1x live (30m) + 1x recorded (20m) — fastest to schedule
- Option B: 2x live (30m each) — may require substitute routing if primary advocates are in Q1 blackout

I'll loop Marissa (sales ops) and Ben (customer success) to check availability and to propose a candidate list.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
